Document Title: Why you are feeling overwhelemed [sic]

Definition:
Bury or drown beneath a huge mass.

Our Definition:
Give too much of a thing to (someone);

Story: (AF 2024)
Clickup Notes

What You Have To Do:
Study -> Research -> Create -> Test -> Feedback Loop -> Repeat

Study: Learning new information to build your knowledge basis
Research: Figure out what people want
Create: Communicate how you can help those people get what they want
Test: Launch tests in 1 campaign. If it gets spend = good. If it does not get spend = not good.
Feedback Loop: Make educated guesses on why your ad is working or not working
Repeat: Go back to researching again, or leverage learnings from feedback loop to make more ads.

frames.title: Google AI Overview: Does the brain like change?
frames.on_screen:
Search query: does the brain like change?

AI Overview
No, the brain generally resists change because it prioritizes predictability, safety, and efficiency by relying on established neural pathways and habits, triggering discomfort or threat responses when routines are disrupted. However, the brain is also wonderfully neuroplastic, meaning it can change and adapt throughout life, especially with small, consistent efforts that build new pathways, allowing for growth and learning, though it takes more work than for a child's developing brain.
